title: Team Standup
description: Daily standup that silently derails: a question nobody answers, a point nobody acknowledges, and a question asked twice.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Morning everyone, quick standup. What did each of you finish yesterday?

transcript.speaker: Bob
transcript.text: I finished the payment API integration.

transcript.speaker: Carol
transcript.text: I wrapped up the onboarding screens.

transcript.speaker: Dave
transcript.text: Mostly bug fixes on the mobile app.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Dave, good - do you know if the staging environment is back up?

transcript.speaker: Bob
transcript.text: I pushed the API docs to Confluence yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Carol
transcript.text: My pull request is still waiting on review.

transcript.speaker: Bob
transcript.text: Sorry, jumping topics - what is the release date again?

transcript.speaker: Dave
transcript.text: I thought it was the 15th, but I am not sure.

transcript.speaker: Carol
transcript.text: To clarify, does the release include the admin dashboard?

transcript.speaker: Carol
transcript.text: Can you clarify which parts of the admin dashboard are in scope?

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Does anyone know why the coupon tests are failing?

transcript.speaker: Bob
transcript.text: It is because the test data expired last week.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: @Bob the login bug is still open.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: I will pick that up myself.

transcript.speaker: Alice
transcript.text: Also the designer handed over the new icons.

transcript.speaker: Carol
transcript.text: Nice, I will review them tomorrow.
